name: Stolen Freewind Supplies
summary: At Freewind Post, Jandia needs the harpies' stolen supplies back. The post has enough for now, but it will soon run short without another shipment.

sections.title: The Missing Shipment
sections.body: The harpies struck the last caravan bound for Freewind Post. Jandia says the post can manage for now, though its stores will not last without more supplies. The harpies' lair lies west of the post, along the cliff base and in a cave above.

faq.answer: Jandia in Freewind Post needs the stolen supplies recovered.
Harpies attacked the last caravan carrying supplies to Freewind Post.
The harpies' lair lies west of Freewind Post, along the cliff base and in a cave above.

faq.q: Why does Jandia need them back?
faq.answer: Freewind Post has enough supplies for now, but it will soon run short without another shipment.

faq.q: What does Jandia ask you to recover?
faq.answer: Jandia asks you to recover eight stolen supplies for Freewind Post.
